nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $w$ a real number. nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and let $k, w$ be real. nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $A$, $B$, $C$ types with $A$ and $C$ finite, and let $T$ be an element of $(F^A \otimes_F F^B) \otimes_F F^C$. For every natural number $r$, $T$ has tensor rank at most $r$ if and only if its coefficient array $A \to B \to C \to F$, obtained by the canonical linear equivalence, has trilinear rank at most $r$.
nodes.title: Tensor rank bounds agree with coefficient rank bounds

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $A$, $B$, $C$ types. nodes.title: Tensor rank at most $r$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a semiring and $A$, $B$, $C$ finite types. Every array $T : A \to B \to C \to F$ has trilinear rank at most $|A| \cdot |B| \cdot |C|$.

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a semiring and $A$, $B$, $C$ finite types. For every array $T : A \to B \to C \to F$ and every natural number $r$, $T$ has trilinear rank at most $r$ if and only if the trilinear rank of $T$ (the least length of a decomposition of $T$ into rank-one arrays) is at most $r$.
nodes.title: Rank bounds via the trilinear rank

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a semiring and $A$, $B$, $C$ types. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
